targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "VMs" FROM inventory.vm_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) AND (${vm:sqlstring}='All' OR vm_key=${vm:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='running') AS "Running" FROM inventory.vm_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) AND (${vm:sqlstring}='All' OR vm_key=${vm:sqlstring})

SELECT round(avg(cpu_utilization_pct),1) AS "CPU" FROM inventory.vm_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) AND (${vm:sqlstring}='All' OR vm_key=${vm:sqlstring})

SELECT round(avg(memory_utilization_pct),1) AS "Memory" FROM inventory.vm_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) AND (${vm:sqlstring}='All' OR vm_key=${vm:sqlstring})

SELECT coalesce(sum(open_alerts),0) AS "Alerts" FROM inventory.vm_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) AND (${vm:sqlstring}='All' OR vm_key=${vm:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE backup_status<>'protected') AS "Backup Risk" FROM inventory.vm_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) AND (${vm:sqlstring}='All' OR vm_key=${vm:sqlstring})

SELECT initcap(health_status) AS "Health",site_name AS "Data Center",rack_name AS "Rack",physical_host AS "Physical Host",name AS "VM",hostname AS "Hostname",vm_key AS "VM Key",status AS "Power State",vcpu_count AS "vCPU",pg_size_pretty(memory_bytes) AS "Memory",pg_size_pretty(provisioned_storage_bytes) AS "Storage",cpu_utilization_pct AS "CPU %",memory_utilization_pct AS "Memory %",storage_utilization_pct AS "Storage %",uptime_pct AS "Uptime %",snapshot_count AS "Snapshots",initcap(backup_status) AS "Backup",open_alerts AS "Alerts",initcap(monitoring_status) AS "Monitoring",operating_system AS "OS",array_to_string(ip_addresses,', ') AS "IP Addresses",owner AS "Owner",last_seen_at AS "Last Seen",CASE WHEN is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.vm_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) AND (${vm:sqlstring}='All' OR vm_key=${vm:sqlstring}) ORDER BY CASE health_status WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,site_name,physical_host,name

list.label: Data Center
list.name: site
list.query: SELECT site_key AS __value,name AS __text FROM inventory.sites ORDER BY name

list.label: Rack
list.name: rack
list.query: SELECT rack_key AS __value,site_name||' / '||name AS __text FROM inventory.rack_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY site_name,name

list.label: Server
list.name: server
list.query: SELECT server_key AS __value,hostname AS __text FROM inventory.server_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) ORDER BY hostname

list.label: Virtual Machine
list.name: vm
list.query: SELECT vm_key AS __value,name AS __text FROM inventory.vm_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) ORDER BY name
